content.description: CardanoBI is the first fully open-source Business Intelligence API Layer on Cardano. CardanoBI is the first fully Open-Source Business Intelligence API Layer for Cardano. We provide on-chain analytics and enable new data-driven services. Our API is organized in 3 domains: Core, Business Intelligence (BI) and Partners. Core: all on-chain data of Cardano (accounts, blocks, transactions, contracts, pools....)
